thread.text:
Today: Incline Bench Press didn't get the prescribed 67.5kg working sets — you ran 60kg×8, 65kg×8, 8, then backed off to 45kg×10. That's three working sets in the 5-8 band, not the four called for, and you never tested 67.5kg. Pull-ups hit second as planned, bodyweight×8, 8, 8, matching 10-19 exactly. Chest Fly started on target at 65kg×10, 10, then dropped to 4 reps on set three and 57.5kg×4 after that — short of the 2×10-12 ask. Reverse Fly and One Handed Triceps Pull both landed clean: reverse fly 42.5kg×10, 10, 10 (an extra set over the two prescribed), triceps pull at the new 10kg×10, 10, 10 as earned. Lateral Raise opened at 8kg×15, 15 but dropped to 7kg×15 on set three, missing the three-at-8kg target.

Trend: Incline's 60/65/65 ramp mirrors 09-21 almost exactly and sits below 09-28's peak of 65/65/70 — three sessions now without a real attempt at 67.5kg, so the anchor's progression rule (four sets to 8) still hasn't been tested. Lateral raise reps have sat at 15 across 09-21, 10-19 and today; 09-28's 16, 16, 16 looks like an outlier rather than the trend.

Right lat: 1/10 during the session — a clean green light. This is the Monday reading for the pull-up gate, which needs 3/10 or under on both Monday and Thursday. Thursday's reading from Upper B's row will decide whether the +5kg comes back.

Next session: Upper B, Thu 29 Oct. Deadlift first at 70kg for 3×5, pull-ups second at bodyweight, then the Iso Lateral Row at L52.5kg/R50kg (or bilateral again if that's your call) — rate pain during the row either way.

Question: incline stalled short of 67.5kg and both chest fly and lateral raise fell off hard on their last working sets — was today a gassed or short-on-time session, or is something else going on?
tired today, chest fly and lateral raise worked more on the eccentric form, so will work from where i am now

Fair enough — fatigue explains the incline fade and the late drops on chest fly and lateral raise, nothing there to flag.

On the eccentric-focus change: that's a genuine form change, so the reps/loads from today aren't on the same scale as before. Worth logging that shift explicitly going forward, otherwise the trend read will look like a regression that isn't one — "worked more on eccentric" matters for comparing against 09-28's 16, 16, 16 or 65kg×12, 12, 8 on chest fly.

Incline still hasn't had a real crack at 67.5kg in three sessions now. If today was just fatigue, next Monday's the one to actually test it fresh rather than defaulting back to the 60/65 ramp.
